rollups.text: Online-spending tracking: From April 2023, the user made at least one online purchase per week, sometimes two or three, and felt overwhelmed by the amount spent. On 2023-05-20, the user planned a spending journal, compared Mint, YNAB, and Personal Capital, leaned toward Mint because it was free and seemed user-friendly, asked about account-linking security, and decided to link financial accounts to Mint to understand spending and reduce mindless shopping.

Hawaii family vacation planning: On 2023-05-21, the user considered an Oahu-and-Maui vacation for approximately 15–20 relatives, including children aged 5–15, with a resort budget of about $500–700 per night. The user liked Aulani, especially its kids' clubs and water park, and wanted to know about group accommodation and discounts; the user planned to contact Aulani. The user also planned to research family activities, arrange several large-group dinners, and experience a traditional luau. No bookings were confirmed.

Data-science learning and NLP project: On 2023-05-21, the user reported spending the prior month improving data-science and programming skills and consuming educational content. The user was particularly interested in deep learning, considered reading Deep Learning by Ian Goodfellow, Yoshua Bengio, and Aaron Courville, watched Andrew Ng statistics lectures on MIT OpenCourseWare, and listened to the Data Science Podcast, including an NLP episode. The user was especially interested in practical NLP such as sentiment analysis and text classification and had recently worked on a customer-sentiment project. The user considered forecasting stock prices with historical prices and news: collecting data through APIs, cleaning and tokenizing text with NLTK and spaCy, testing TF-IDF or embeddings, combining sentiment approaches and machine-learning models, and extracting sentiment, entities, and topics. On 2023-05-26, the user requested a beginner-friendly explanation of a TextBlob sentiment-analysis notebook and corrected an omission about its sentiment-assessment loop.

Backyard gardening: Around February 2023, the user cleared the backyard and started a small vegetable garden. By 2023-05-22, the user was growing tomatoes, cucumbers, and carrots from nursery plants, plus basil, mint, and parsley used in cooking; after adjusting watering, the plants were doing well and the user had begun harvesting tomatoes. The user used neem oil and soap solution against aphids and whiteflies, added neem cake, began composting kitchen waste, and attended a community gardening workshop on composting and mulching. The user planned to use compost and expand the garden, considering sunflowers, zinnias, bell peppers, eggplants, more produce, and companion plants for pest control and soil health.

Paris study-abroad preparation: On 2023-05-23, the user reported that a visa had recently been approved after a two-week wait following the appointment and planned to live in Paris's 11th arrondissement. The user planned to try recommended restaurants, explore museums and galleries, look into art- and history-related volunteering, and begin with a guided tour covering the 11th arrondissement and nearby neighborhoods to learn local history and layout. These were plans and recommendations, not confirmed visits or bookings.

Japan trip research: On 2023-05-26, the user was planning a trip to Japan and sought YouTube travel vlogs and guides, particularly for food and cultural insights. The user planned to set a goal and timer for each trip-planning session, considered booking a food-focused guided tour, and was excited by a video about hot-food and drink vending machines. The user wanted to try foods including sushi, ramen, tempura, mochi, matcha desserts, okonomiyaki, and takoyaki, and was concerned about communicating with restaurant staff and vendors without speaking Japanese. No booking or travel date was stated.
